content.subject: Sluice — self-hosted webhook inbox
facts: Name: Sluice — a self-hosted inbox for webhooks
What it does: gives you a public URL for webhooks, stores every delivery, and forwards it to your local or internal service
One static binary, about 11 MB, for Linux, macOS and Windows on amd64 and arm64
Storage: a single SQLite file; no Redis, no Postgres, no queue to run
Install: curl -fsSL https://sluice.example/install.sh | sh
Start: sluice serve --forward http://localhost:3000
Retries failed forwards with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours
Replay any stored delivery: sluice replay <delivery-id>
Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signatures and rejects deliveries older than 5 minutes
Web UI on port 8081: search deliveries by path, header or body text
Keeps deliveries for 30 days by default; change it with --retain
1,800 deliveries per second on a 2-vCPU VM, in the project's own benchmark
No hosted service, no account, no telemetry
Written in Go; MIT licence; 41 contributors
Current version 0.9.2, released 14 October 2026
Maintainer: Ines Okafor, who started it in 2023 after losing a weekend of payment webhooks

concept.zh: 五十到八十年代的黑胶封套：正面是一个正方形——狠狠裁切的照片、巨大的字，或几乎什么都没有；背面是密密的曲目表、录音信息和目录号。Blue Note 的爵士张力，ECM 的冷静留白，Factory 的编号与克制。
concept.en: The 1950s–80s LP sleeve: the front is a square — a brutally cropped photo, enormous type, or almost nothing; the back is a dense track listing, recording credits and a catalogue number. Blue Note's jazz tension, ECM's cool silence, Factory's numbering and restraint.

references: Reid Miles — Blue Note Records sleeves (1956–67)
Barbara Wojirsch & Dieter Rehm — ECM Records covers
Peter Saville — Factory Records (FAC numbers, "Unknown Pleasures", "Power, Corruption & Lies")
Alex Steinweiss — Columbia Records sleeves (1940s)
Hipgnosis — sleeves for Pink Floyd and Led Zeppelin

tokens.grid: Square module: the cover is 1:1 at min(92vw, 88vh) with an internal 12×12 square grid; the back cover uses 3 columns with 12px gutters.
tokens.radius: 0 for sleeves; the disc is a circle (border-radius: 50%) with a label circle at 33% of its diameter.
tokens.border: No borders on the cover; back-cover credits use 1px rules; a 12px spine strip where needed.
tokens.shadow: none. Wear is shown with a ring-wear mark (thin radial ring) instead of a shadow.

must: The first screen contains a perfect 1:1 square composition.
A catalogue number and an ordered listing (A1, A2… or 01, 02…) appear on the page.
Type or image is cropped by the square edge at least once — or, in the ECM option, the square is ≥85% empty.
mustNot: No wide rectangular hero banner; the cover is square.
No streaming-app UI: no circular play buttons, progress bars or heart icons.
No invented track names, credits or durations — only items from the facts.

voice.description: 邮购目录条目：货号、品名、规格、价格，每条结构一致，靠排版而非形容词取胜。
voice.example: No.07 黑麦面包 · 750 g · 每日限 12 个 · ¥42

layout.name: Blue Note crop
layout.description: Reid Miles-style: an extreme tight crop (photo or giant letters) fills two thirds of the square; the title stacks in condensed caps against one edge inside a single strong colour band.
layout.grid: 12×12 square grid; crop occupies rows 1–8, type band rows 9–12; type may bleed off the square edge.
structure: Square with a photo or letterform crop in rows 1–8, tinted in one colour
Type band: name in giant condensed caps, title in a contrasting weight
Catalogue label top-right in the "BLUE NOTE 1577" manner, using the subject's own code
Under the sleeve: session details table (date, place, people) with 1px rules

anchor.name: Cropped giant type
anchor.description: The name in condensed caps so large the square edges cut it; only 60–70% of the letters are visible.

type.name: League Gothic + Libre Franklin
type.notes: League Gothic uppercase at huge sizes (up to 30vw), line-height 0.82, tracking 0; it is allowed to be cut by the square edge. Libre Franklin 900 for the title line in mixed case, 400 for credits at 13px/1.5. Durations in tabular figures, right-aligned.

palette.name: Factory black
palette.usage: Black sleeve and page; off-white type; red and yellow as small solid colour-code blocks or a single line of type (<10%); grey rules on the back cover.

density.description: 大留白，一屏只讲一件事；正文行长 60–68 字符（中文 30–36 字）。

motion.name: Still sleeve
motion.description: No motion; hover underlines a title and turns its duration to accent.

motif.name: Side A / Side B
motif.description: Any ordered facts listed as SIDE A / SIDE B with A1…B4 numbering, titles and right-aligned tabular durations or values.

surface.name: Laminated flipback
surface.description: Crisp, flat front; the back cover has a 6px folded flipback strip on its left edge.
surface.css: .sleeve { background: var(--panel); } .back { position: relative; } .back::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 6px; background: var(--rule); }

twist.description: 全页恰好一个元素打破栅格：旋转、出血或越过边距。其余一切严格对齐。

concept.zh: 白立方展厅的墙面说明与展览图录：一面墙只挂一件作品，旁边一张小小的展签写着作者、标题、年代、材质、尺寸。图录里大量留白、连续的图版编号、档案灰——克制本身就是权威。
concept.en: White-cube wall texts and exhibition catalogues: one work per wall, a small label beside it giving artist, title, year, medium and dimensions. In the catalogue: wide margins, continuous plate numbers, archival grey — restraint is the authority.

references: MoMA exhibition catalogues and wall labels (1960s–)
Wim Crouwel — Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam catalogues (1964–85)
documenta 5 catalogue, Kassel (1972)
Brian O’Doherty — Inside the White Cube (1976)
Steidl and Walther König artist monographs

tokens.grid: Catalogue grid: 12 col, 24px gutter, outer margins ≥ 12vw on desktop; a hanging line at 40% of viewport height on which works/plates are centred; captions on a 4px baseline grid.
tokens.border: Almost none: 1px solid var(--rule) hairlines for the running head and under plate captions; images unbordered except white-on-white works (1px var(--rule)).
tokens.shadow: none. Foam-board labels are shown by a 1px var(--rule) outline, not by shadow.

must: Every work or item has a tombstone with maker, title and year from the facts — omit a line rather than invent it.
At least 40% of each first screen is empty wall.
Titles of works are italic; plate numbers are continuous.
The exhibition title is never larger than 72px.
mustNot: No carousels, hover-zoom or captions overlaid on images.
No centred or justified body text; labels are flush-left ragged-right.
No more than one accent mark per screen.

voice.description: 说明书口吻：编号条款、动词开头、规格写全，零形容词。
voice.example: 3.2 取货：报预订号 → 核对 → 取走。逾时 30 分钟释放库存。

layout.name: Archive checklist
layout.description: An archival register: tombstone entries in a measured grid with plate boxes and accession-style numbers, sections in a sticky left rail.
layout.grid: 12 col; left 2 col sticky section rail; entries span 3 col each (4:3 plate box + 5-line tombstone); 48px row gap.
structure: Register header: title, date range, number of works (from the facts)
Sticky section labels in the left rail
Entries: number, plate box, tombstone lines
Notes on the works: numbered endnotes
Credits and lenders

anchor.name: Vinyl title wall
anchor.description: The entry wall: exhibition title in vinyl lettering top-left at modest size, dates and venue below, everything else empty wall.

type.name: Cormorant + EB Garamond
type.notes: Titles of works always italic. Exhibition title Cormorant 400 at ≤ 64px — the catalogue never shouts. Plate numbers in all-small-caps ("Pl. 12"); old-style figures in running text, lining in dimensions ("120 × 90 cm" with a true ×). Body 17px/1.6, max 58ch.

palette.name: White cube
palette.usage: Wall paper ≥ 85% of the area; ink text; muted for credit lines and dimensions; accent only as the 10px red dot and the current room number; panel behind the checklist.

lines.verdict: large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Still wall
motion.description: No motion; links are 1px underlines offset 3px.

motif.name: Red dot
motif.description: A single 10px solid accent circle — the gallery "sold" dot — used at most once per screen for the one item that matters.

surface.name: Uncoated stock
surface.description: Uncoated catalogue paper with a barely visible fibre grain.
surface.css: background-color: var(--paper); background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.025) .6px, transparent .8px); background-size: 4px 5px;

twist.description: 导航放在底部、侧边竖排或做成目录/索引，而不是顶部横条。

concept.zh: 大型机与哑终端的屏幕：黑底上发光的绿色或琥珀色等宽字，制表符画出的方框和表格，提示符后面一个闪烁的光标。结构来自 man page：NAME、SYNOPSIS、DESCRIPTION，一切都装进 80 列。
concept.en: The screen of a mainframe or dumb terminal: green or amber phosphor monospace on black, box-drawing characters for panels and tables, a blinking cursor after the prompt. Structure comes from the man page — NAME, SYNOPSIS, DESCRIPTION — and everything fits in 80 columns.

references: DEC VT100 / VT220 terminals (1978–83)
IBM 3270 display stations and ISPF panels
Unix Programmer’s Manual and the man(1) page format, Bell Labs (1971–79)
Lear Siegler ADM-3A and Zenith Z-19 green/amber phosphor screens
IBM 1403 line printer and green-bar continuous paper

tokens.grid: Character grid: everything in ch and line units — 80ch max width (132ch for wide tables), line-height 1.25; columns are integer ch widths (e.g. 24ch | 56ch); spacing in whole lines, never px gaps that break the cell grid.
tokens.radius: 0 for all UI. The only curve is the optional CRT bezel around the whole screen (border-radius 18px on the outer frame).
tokens.border: Boxes drawn with box-drawing characters (┌─┐│└┘, double ╔═╗ for the primary panel) as text, or at most 1px solid var(--accent); nothing thicker.
tokens.shadow: none on elements. Phosphor bloom only as text-shadow: 0 0 2px currentColor (≤ 3px blur); nothing else glows.

must: All text is monospace on a ch grid; line length ≤ 80ch (132ch for tables).
At least one structure borrowed from terminals: prompt + output, man-page sections, or a PF-key form panel.
Emphasis by reverse video, brightness (accent) or underline — never size jumps larger than 2×, except one ASCII banner.
mustNot: No neon blur, chromatic aberration or "matrix rain".
No proportional fonts anywhere, including nav and buttons.
No invented system output or hacker jargon — every line carries a fact.
No rounded buttons; controls are [ bracketed ] or underlined fields.

voice.description: 写给一个具体读者的信：第一人称、第二人称、具体的回忆和邀请，有落款。
voice.example: 你好——如果你周六早上路过，门会开着，桌上有刚切的面包。

layout.name: Man page
layout.description: The page reads as a man page: header line, NAME, SYNOPSIS, DESCRIPTION, OPTIONS, SEE ALSO, with 7ch indentation.
layout.grid: One 80ch column at 2ch from the left; section heads at col 0, body indented 7ch, option flags hanging-indented 7ch / 14ch.
structure: Header line: TITLE(1) at both ends with the manual name centred
NAME: the title — one-line summary
SYNOPSIS: the core offer written as a command with [options]
DESCRIPTION: paragraphs indented 7ch
OPTIONS / FILES / SEE ALSO built from the facts; footer line with date and version

anchor.name: ASCII banner
anchor.description: The title as a large block-character banner (█ ▀ ▄) inside a double-line ╔═╗ frame.

type.name: IBM Plex Mono + Fira Code
type.notes: Mainframe panel voice: titles in Plex Mono 700 uppercase at 1–2× body only (no big type on a 3270). Body Fira Code 15px with font-variant-ligatures: none. Field labels followed by ". . . :" leaders; protected text in muted, input in ink.

palette.name: P3 amber phosphor
palette.usage: Warm amber monochrome: ink for text, pale accent for headings and the cursor, orange accent2 only for errors; rule-brown box lines; panel for inactive panes.

density.description: 信息密集，多栏并行；用细线和对齐建立秩序，首屏就能看到 3 个以上信息块。

motion.name: Cursor blink
motion.description: A block cursor (█, 1ch × 1.25em) after the last prompt blinks 530ms on / 530ms off — the only moving thing on the screen.

motif.name: Reverse video
motif.description: Headings, the selected menu item and the status bar in reverse video (accent background, paper text) spanning whole ch widths.

surface.name: Green-bar paper
surface.description: Continuous line-printer paper: 3 lines of panel tint, 3 lines of paper, tractor holes in the margins.
surface.css: background-color: var(--paper); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--panel) 0 3.75em, transparent 3.75em 7.5em);

twist.description: 每个区块有显眼的编号（§1、No.2、03…），编号本身是设计元素。

concept.zh: LaTeX 排出的研究论文：标题和作者居中，摘要单独成块，章节按 1、1.1 编号，图注表注都有编号，页脚有脚注，文末是参考文献。可信感来自严格的编号体系和交叉引用，而不是装饰。
concept.en: A research paper typeset in LaTeX: title and authors centred, a set-off abstract, sections numbered 1 and 1.1, numbered figure and table captions, footnotes and a references list. Authority comes from the numbering system and cross-references, not from decoration.

references: Donald Knuth, TeX and Computer Modern (1978–86); the AMS amsart document class
Edward Tufte’s handouts and the tufte-latex class (sidenotes, margin figures)
Physical Review Letters and Nature two-column journal pages
Simon Fear, the booktabs LaTeX package (1995) — three-rule tables
arXiv preprints, 1991–

tokens.grid: Text block 34em (≈ 600px) single column, or 2 × 20em columns with a 2em gap; page margins in the LaTeX article proportion (text width ≈ 62% of the page); baseline = 1.25 × body size; floats span one column or the full text width.
tokens.border: booktabs only: \toprule and \bottomrule 1.5px ink, \midrule 1px ink, no vertical rules in tables; abstract framed by a 1px ink box or none; footnote separator 1px ink at 40% of the text width.

must: Sections, figures and tables are numbered, and every one is referenced in the text.
A delimited abstract (or an epigraph in the Tufte layout) precedes section 1.
Claims are tied to sources listed in the references, taken from the facts.
mustNot: No cards, badges, icons or call-to-action buttons; links are inline text.
No coloured section backgrounds; colour is limited to links and figure data.
No invented authors, DOIs, journals or citations that are not in the facts.

voice.description: 船长/值班日志：按条目记录，时间戳 + 事件 + 签名缩写，事实化、略带幽默。
voice.example: 0630 炉温达标。0700 开门，门外 4 人。—— L.

layout.name: Tufte handout
layout.description: A wide right margin carries sidenotes, margin figures and citations next to the text they support; there are no footnotes at the bottom.
layout.grid: 12 columns: text spans 1–7 (≈ 55%), sidenote column spans 9–12; full-width figures span 1–12; sidenote numbers superscript in text and on the baseline in the margin.
structure: Title in large italic + author in small caps; an epigraph instead of an abstract
Section headings in italic; paragraphs open with “new thought” small caps
Body paragraphs with sidenotes and margin figures alongside
One full-width figure or small-multiples table
Bibliography as short sidenote citations plus a compact list at the end

anchor.name: Title + abstract
anchor.description: The first screen is the centred title block plus the set-off abstract — dense, quiet and complete.

type.name: Crimson Pro
type.notes: Crimson Pro 400 italic for the title (2.4×) and section headings (1.4×), never bold; body 400 at 19px/1.5, ragged-right; paragraph openers in font-variant-caps: all-small-caps with 0.05em tracking; sidenotes at 0.75× with the number on the baseline. Oldstyle figures (onum) in prose, lining in tables.

palette.name: Preprint white
palette.usage: Practically monochrome: ink on white for ~97% of the page. Dark red (accent) only for cross-reference links (Fig. 1, Eq. 3, §2); green (accent2) only for citation brackets [12]; panel for the abstract box.

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Still
motion.description: No motion: links are coloured, hover adds a 1px underline.

motif.name: Numbered captions
motif.description: Run-in bold “Figure 3.” / “Table 2.” labels with smaller caption text; every float is referenced from the body.

surface.name: PDF page
surface.description: A white page on a grey reader background with a hairline edge, like a PDF at 100% zoom.
surface.css: body { background: var(--panel); } main { background: var(--paper); max-width: 816px; margin: 32px auto; padding: 96px 72px; outline: 1px solid var(--rule); }

twist.description: 用真实的时间/日期（营业时间、出炉时刻、日程）作为页面的主结构轴。

concept.zh: 科研实验记录本和工程方格计算纸：方格底，手写结论旁边是等宽字的注释，有草图、测量数据表，每条记录写日期并签名，写错了就划一道线而不是擦掉。页面是一份正在进行、可以追溯的工作记录。
concept.en: The research lab notebook and the engineer’s computation pad: grid paper, handwritten conclusions beside monospace annotations, sketches, measurement tables, every entry dated and signed, mistakes struck through with a single line instead of erased. The page is a running, traceable record of work.

references: Michael Faraday’s laboratory notebooks (Royal Institution, 1820s–60s)
National Brand green computation notebooks with 4×4 quad ruling
Engineering computation pads on green eye-ease paper (Ampad, Roaring Spring)
Bell Labs engineering notebooks with dated, witnessed pages
Leonardo da Vinci, Codex Arundel — mirror-written notes beside sketches

tokens.grid: 20px square grid (5mm) across the page, major line every 100px; every block’s width and height are multiples of 20px; 80px left margin (4 squares) with a 1px red margin line; baselines sit on grid lines (line-height 20px or 40px).
tokens.radius: 0. Circles around results are hand-drawn SVG ellipses with uneven strokes, not CSS radii.
tokens.border: Grid 1px var(--rule), major lines slightly darker; boxes drawn as 1.5px ink “hand” strokes (SVG paths with ±1px jitter) or 1px ruled tables on the grid; answer boxes double-outlined (3px double ink).
tokens.shadow: none. Taped-in printouts get translucent tape strips at the corners, not shadows.

must: A visible grid underlies the page and blocks align to it.
Every entry or section carries a date and an entry or page number.
Handwriting is used for titles and remarks, mono for data — both appear on the first screen.
At least one table of values with units in its header.
mustNot: No erasing: corrections are struck through, never silently replaced.
Handwriting faces never set paragraphs longer than two lines.
No stock science imagery: no beakers, DNA helices or glowing molecules.

voice.description: 观察者的记录：带日期、时间、度量和第一手细节，克制、不评价。
voice.example: 06:40 — 窗内温度 31°C，面团第二次发酵完成（目测体积 ×2）。

layout.name: Dated entries
layout.description: The page is a sequence of notebook entries, each opening with a date, a hand-underlined title and an entry number; sections are entries.
layout.grid: 20px grid; content from x = 80px to max 880px; dates in the 0–80px margin; entries separated by a full-width hand-drawn line.
structure: Page header in mono: notebook title, “Book 3 · p. 47”, owner
Entry 1 (dated): aim written by hand, then mono notes
Entry 2: measurement table ruled to the grid, units in the header
Entry 3: an SVG line sketch with labelled arrows
Signature and “Witnessed by / date” block at the page foot

anchor.name: Annotated sketch
anchor.description: A large single-weight line sketch of the subject with 4–6 handwritten labels and arrows fills the first screen.

type.name: Caveat + IBM Plex Mono
type.notes: Caveat 500/700 for entry titles, conclusions and margin remarks at 28–44px on a 40px line so it sits on the grid; remarks may rotate −1° to 1°. IBM Plex Mono 400 at 14px/20px for data, notes and tables (one line per grid row); units always with a space (“12.5 mL”).

palette.name: Green computation pad
palette.usage: Eye-ease green paper with green grid (rule); graphite ink text; red (accent) for corrections, the margin line and answer boxes; blue ballpoint (accent2) for handwritten remarks and arrows; panel for header strips and taped-in printouts.

lines.verdict: large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Strike-through correction
motion.description: A value that changes (updated hours, a new price) keeps the old value, a line draws through it left → right, then the new value is written beside it.
motion.reduced: Show the struck-through old value and the new value without animation.

motif.name: Struck-through corrections
motif.description: Errors left visible under a single line, with the correction and initials beside — the honesty of the record.

surface.name: Taped-in printout
surface.description: White printout rectangles taped onto the page with translucent tape strips at two corners, rotated about 1°.
surface.css: .taped { background: #fffefa; position: relative; transform: rotate(-.8deg); } .taped::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 24px; width: 80px; height: 22px; background: rgba(240,232,200,.65); transform: rotate(-4deg); }

twist.description: 每个区块有显眼的编号（§1、No.2、03…），编号本身是设计元素。

trace.note: primary branch (or its family) already used in this roll; walked forward 5 step(s)
